body:
## DM-268 evidence detail (worker)

### c1 criterion -> test
- DM-169 c1 -> src/core/space/contract.test.ts 'DM-169 c1: checked-in fixtures parse against the contracts' (observations/baselines/policy/rubric fixtures parse to themselves; observed/estimated/missing covered) + 'malformed observations/baselines and subjects/grade inputs, grades and policies are refused'.
- DM-169 c2 -> src/core/space/rubric.test.ts 'DM-169 c2: policy v1 weights and bands' (letterFor at 89.999999/90 ... 59.999999/60, display floor) + 'worked examples regrade byte for byte' (complete 85.357143 B, failure 79.166667->59 F).
- DM-169 c3 -> rubric.test.ts 'DM-169 c3: missing verification is Ungraded and a confirmed failure caps at F' + 'incomplete other factors are Provisional or Ungraded, never imputed success'.
- DM-169 c4 -> src/core/space/baselines.test.ts 'fixture subjects choose the expected baseline', 'editing a budget cannot improve an executing assessment', 'unparseable or non-ISO times fail closed', 'cohort eligibility and ordering', 'level and roll-up checks'; rubric.test.ts 'DM-169 c4: the grader rechecks the baseline it is handed'.
- DM-170 c1 -> src/core/db/ledgerMigration.test.ts 'DM-170 c1: the ledger migration opens existing repositories unchanged' (hashes unchanged, legacy records byte for byte) + 'DM-170 c1: newer storage is refused safely' (incompatible_schema, newer formatVersion rejected, nothing stored).
- DM-170 c2 -> src/core/services/observations.test.ts 'repeated observation ids are idempotent', 'a changed payload under the same id conflicts', 'invalid usage is refused', 'unknown ownership and references are refused', 'unknown evidence references are refused, and a refused batch stores nothing'.
- DM-170 c3 -> src/core/repo/observationRecords.test.ts 'machine-local paths, credentials and claim secrets never reach the ledger', 'exported record files keep identity and provenance only', 'interrupted-outbox recovery', 'another machine imports the same observations', 'imports never leave dangling or self citations'.
- DM-170 c4 -> observations.test.ts 'unknown is distinct from zero and estimates', 'work in every end state stays attributable', 'carry-forward references never duplicate execution'; observationRecords.test.ts 'work stays attributable after adopting a revision that removes its ticket'.
- DM-171 c1 -> src/core/commands/metrics.test.ts 'DM-171 c1: allowed scoped reporting succeeds', 'cross-attempt writes and missing proof are refused' (stale_claim/unauthorized), 'stale and expired claims are fenced' (expired_claim, stale_claim after retry), 'a submitted attempt's claim is stale', 'agent-authored human feedback and server measures are refused', 'roles without a reporting capability are refused'.
- DM-171 c2 -> src/core/services/metricReports.test.ts 'delta reports are identified by their source event' (2,000 not 4,000 after redelivery), 'cumulative reports are identified by their sequence' (400 not summed), 'identity and units are explicit', 'nested inclusive usage is counted once' (+ across buckets), 'one delivery reported by agent and host counts once', 'unknown usage stays unknown'.
- DM-171 c3 -> src/core/services/plannedBaselines.test.ts 'saved budgets are frozen by the server and pinned at dispatch', 'budget edits participate in the draft', 'a late save is a prospective version, not a retroactive raise', 'adopting the revision moves only undispatched tickets', 'versions travel with the saved plan snapshots'; src/core/services/ticketBudgets.test.ts 'a budget set on a dispatched ticket is prospective', 'a person's estimate is labelled only by a person'.
- DM-172 c1 -> src/core/space/timing.test.ts 'DM-172 c1: interval projection on the checked-in deterministic clock fixtures' (all 13 fixtures exact, no negatives, 5 shuffled arrival orders identical) + pause/missing-stop/lease/duplicate/overlap boundary describes; src/core/services/timing.test.ts lifecycle describes.
- DM-172 c2 -> timing.test.ts 'the four named measures are four distinct quantity kinds' (+expectTypeOf), 'missing measures stay missing', 'DM-172 c2 (review #18): a missing measure never reads as fully covered'; timingIntervals.test.ts 'c2/c4: quantities state their coverage; missing is never zero'.
- DM-172 c3 -> timing.test.ts 'summed effort, the wall clocks and the window are distinct numbers; reviewer and orchestrator overhead stay visible'; services/timing.test.ts 'DM-172 c3: parallel workers on real records'.
- DM-172 c4 -> timing.test.ts 'a failed attempt that reported nothing has missing effort (null, never 0)', 'a superseded attempt counts in the superseded bucket'; services/timing.test.ts 'DM-172 c4: rejected, expired and failed attempts ...'.
- DM-173 c1 -> src/core/space/hostUsage.test.ts 'provider samples normalize to each provider definition' (cached-input 14461 incl 1500, reasoning subsets), 'cumulative updates count each token once', 'parent/child inclusion through the metric services' (10000 not 13000, raw.service_tier kept); hostTranscripts.test.ts 'Claude Code recorded fixture'.
- DM-173 c2 -> src/core/space/hostAttribution.test.ts 'OMP recorded session' (attempt totals, orchestration 102660, unattributed 154620 visible), 'Claude Code recorded session', 'claim changes and foreign ids inside one session'; hostTranscripts.test.ts 'session links drawn from the transcript'.
- DM-173 c3 -> hostAttribution.test.ts 'one session across two runs' (reused thread fix), 'every attempted piece of work counts once' (rejected/retried/failed/superseded/canceled/carry-forward; list_price, no marginal cost), 'read order never double-counts (3n, 3n+1, 3n+2)'.
- DM-173 c4 -> src/cli/usage.test.ts 'DM-173 c4' describes (unsupported host unavailable everywhere, run totals missing host_unavailable, no stored number); hostAttribution.test.ts 'stays unknown, never 0'.

### c2 Mutation record (each break restored; final runs on restored code):
- baselines.ts freezeDefect '>=' -> '>': fails 'a budget frozen exactly at dispatch is not pre-dispatch...' and 'a roll-up member frozen at or after its own dispatch is refused'. Also reverting the ISO fix (instantOf -> Date.parse) fails the '9999'/'2026-11-02' invalid_time tests.
- rubric.ts displayScore floor -> round: fails 'display rounds 89.99/89.96/59.999999 down...', 'complete: ... 85.3', 'complete'/'sparse' byte-for-byte regrade.
- contract.ts quantity min(0) removed: fails 'negative tokens'.
- observations.ts forward-citation check disabled: fails 'citing a later entry of the same call...', 'a mutual citation in one call is refused'; allocator 'last = fresh': fails 'ids generated in one instant ... call order', 'server ids of one call ... both machines'; carry-forward guard -> 'work': end-state and carry-forward tests fail.
- migrations.ts V19 SQL -> 'SELECT 1;': fails 'the allocator's per-instant lookup uses an index'; 'from > target' -> '+1': fails 'a database newer than SCHEMA_VERSION is refused'.
- ids.ts 'conflict' -> 'invalid_input': fails 'an all-z body has no successor'.
- metricReports.ts role check flipped: fails 'a worker without a claim token...', 'the orchestrator relays host usage...', 'a worker whose lease expired...'; dropped .slice(-1): fails 'a cumulative stream counts its latest total, 400'; overhead dropped from delivery id: fails 'the overhead kind is part of the delivery identity'.
- plannedBaselines.ts pinnedIndex off by one: 13 tests fail incl. 'the raise mid-run is version 2, prospective'. ticketBudgets.ts dispatchedAt === null -> !==: fails 'applies to later dispatches only'. drafts.ts person-estimate guard flipped: both person-estimate tests fail.
- timing.ts unclaimed ignored: fails 'an attempt with events but no claim...'; PRIORITY.active 100->75: fails 'pause-resume' fixture and pause-boundary tests; clip(span.covers)->clip(span): fails 'inclusive worker with an unscoped sub-agent ... 80 of 80'.
- timingActivity.ts preferHost back to dropping whole agent span: fails 'host 10:00-10:10 and agent 10:20-11:00 do not overlap', 'an agent span loses only the time...'. timingIntervals.ts iso without Math.trunc: fails 'truncates a fractional millisecond'. services/timing.ts sprint alias null: fails 'after an adoption renames the active sprint...'.
- hostAttribution.ts inWindow(pass, thread.startedAt) restored: fails 'a worker thread reused by run 2...'. hostTranscripts.ts link every id: fails 'a start_run answer citing another run id links only the run it started'. hostUsage.ts total '<' -> '>': fails codex rollout and 'a running total that drops starts a new base'. cli/usage.ts every -> some: fails 'an orchestration bucket already holding real usage keeps it'.

### c3 Checks pass: 20 new/touched test files (696 tests) via DM_DESKTOP_PIPE= DM_SESSION_TOKEN= npx vitest run (also with --sequence.shuffle seed 4242: 696 pass); npx oxlint on every added/modified src file: 0 findings; npm run typecheck: clean.
Product fixes (all within DM-169..173 scope):
1 (DM-169, baselines.ts + contract.ts isIsoTime): selectBaseline/baselineDefect accepted non-ISO times Date.parse understands ('9999'); now only ISO offset date-times count, else invalid_time. Pinned by baselines.test.ts 'unparseable or non-ISO times fail closed'.
2 (DM-170, observations.ts checkCallReferences): an observation citing a LATER entry of the same call (and so any mutual citation) is refused invalid_input, nothing stored (decision: same-call citations only to earlier entries). Pinned in observations.test.ts + observationRecords.test.ts 'citing an earlier entry ... imports cleanly'.
3 (DM-170, migrations.ts V19, SCHEMA_VERSION 18->19): index metric_observations_recorded(recorded_at, id) for the id allocator; pinned via EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN (COVERING INDEX). migrations.test.ts version pins moved to 19.
4 (DM-170, ids.ts): nextStableId overflow throws DomainError 'conflict' {id}, not a plain Error. Pinned in ids.test.ts and observations.test.ts.
5 (DM-170): same-call order incl. after export/import needed no code change; pinned with a counting-down id generator.
6 (DM-172, timingActivity.ts preferHost): agent spans lost whole when the host reported the same identity; now only the time host spans cover is dropped (host 10:00-10:10 + agent 10:20-11:00 = 50 min).
7 (DM-172, timingActivity.ts Span.covers + timing.ts workerEvidence): inclusive worker with an unscoped sub-agent left a hole (60 of 80 min); now active 80 of 80, effort still counted once.
8 (DM-172, timing.ts, review #18): attempts with events but no claim were invisible to coverage (in-flight read 1 of 1); now counted, uncovered, totals partial.
9 (DM-173, hostAttribution.ts bucketAt): thread reused across runs counted in both; now inWindow(pass, at) (sample time). 
10 (DM-173, hostTranscripts.ts linkCall): a start_run answer citing another run id linked that run too; now only the run view's own (first) id links.
docs/space-grading.md updated for 6-8.

### c4
Unknown stays unknown: contract.test.ts 'a missing measurement parses without a value'; rubric.test.ts sparse (E/T/K score null, weight 0, not 0 or 100), 'an observed zero token total is missing (zero_observation)', 'partial_telemetry'; baselines.test.ts missing selection has no baseline; observations.test.ts 'DM-170 c4: unknown is distinct from zero and estimates'; metricReports.test.ts 'unknown usage stays unknown' (value null, total missing not_reported) and 'a known gap keeps the run total unknown' (partial_coverage); timing.test.ts 'missing measures stay missing' / failed attempt effort null never 0; timingIntervals.test.ts 'missing is never zero'; hostAttribution.test.ts / cli/usage.test.ts unavailable hosts null, never 0.

### c5
Real collaborators only: in-memory SQLite via createTestCtx/createHarness, memory fs repoEnv, checked-in fixtures read in place; no vi.mock/spyOn/fake timers in the new tests (grep), test clocks only, fresh world per test, no temp folders. New additive helper src/test/metricsWorld.ts (new file). Scratch deleted: scratch/DM-169, DM-172, DM-173 entirely; DM-170 all but shared.ts (still imported by scratch/DM-178/c4-reassess.ts); DM-171 c1/c2/c3/fix-round deleted, c4-external-host.ts + shared.ts kept because DM-171 c4 belongs to DM-271 (c4 imports shared.ts). Mock-to-assert ratio well under 1.5 (no mocks). Fireguard not run (left to DM-198).
